lead: Test build 0.8.22b (branch round-0.8.22, CI run 39044254597, version 0.8.22): the complete REMOTE page (template and knob names, MIDI string with info, the knob template list from your Access files, LOAD/SAVE of template files, sent to the Virus like the original), the original's column rule for value lists, and after the first Linux results: the patch and bank menus use the system's own menus again on macOS and Windows (they may use the whole screen like the original's), on Linux a submenu never covers its parent; choosing a template shows it on the LCD; the REMOTE text fields fit. Already done: Linux L3 pass. Mark each item, add a note where something looks different, then copy the results at the bottom into the chat.
rules: Disposable DAW project only. No firmware or OS update, no "Burn To Flash", no factory reset, no storing patches (LOAD in the patch menus is fine, SAVE there is not).
On the REMOTE page SAVE is fine: it writes template files only (a new file "MY TEST.vrt" in Documents/Access Music/Virus TI/Remote Templates; delete it afterwards if you like).
Order this time: Linux first (the Virus is on this PC), then the Windows 11 VM, macOS last. Close the DAW before moving the Virus.

sections.title: Linux
sections.where: REAPER via pw-jack, Virus on this PC
prep: Claude unpacks the new build to ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.22b-linux. In a terminal: cd ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.22b-linux/TI-Revive-0.8.22-linux && sudo ./install.sh
notes: Results so far: L1 FAIL (the 128 patches covered the bank list), L2 FAIL (text fields too big, no LCD info on a double-click), L3 pass. L4 and L5 are the redos.

items.title: Patch and bank menus (redo of L1)
steps: Part 1: LOAD, over the device entry, over RAM A: the 128 patches. Then move to RAM B, RAM C and ROM A.
Pick a patch from ROM A. BROWSER: the upper bank bar's arrow, pick another bank.
items.expect: when RAM A opens, the bank list moves left so the patches sit next to it, never on top of it; RAM B, RAM C, ROM A stay reachable and switch the patch list; the patch loads; the browser shows the bank.

items.title: REMOTE page (redo of L2)
steps: PATCH UTILITY > REMOTE. Single-click template 3 (it is only highlighted), then double-click it.
Click the Template Name field, type MY TEST, Return. Click knob VALUE 2, click the KNOB NAME field, type CUT, Return.
Arrow at the right end of MIDI STRING: Control Change > Volume (Ctrl 7) on Ch 1. Then set MIDI Channel Behaviour to Enable and back to Disable.
Close and reopen the plug-in window (or the DAW project).
items.expect: after the double-click the LCD shows "Remote Templates Selected Temp" and the template name; the list shows MY TEST at 3; the text fields fit their boxes while typing; VALUE 2's name CUT; MIDI STRING B0 07 * with the info line Control Change Ch 1, 7, Value above it; the channel menu changes; after reopening everything is still there; the Virus keeps playing normally.

sections.title: macOS
prep: Claude pushed the package to the Mac: ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.22b-mac. Quit Ableton, then in Terminal: sudo installer -pkg ~/Downloads/TI-Revive-0.8.22b-mac/"TI Revive.pkg" -target /
notes: The patch LOAD/SAVE menus and the browser bank menu are the macOS menus again (like the original's on the Mac). Value lists, the size menu and the REMOTE menus are drawn by the plug-in.

items.title: Patch and bank menus
steps: Part 1: click LOAD. Move over the device entry, then over RAM A: the 128 patches. Move back and over Personal Libraries.
With the keyboard: Down, Right (opens the submenu), Left (closes it), Esc.
Pick a patch from ROM A with a click. BROWSER page: click the arrow of the upper bank bar, pick another bank.
items.expect: the macOS menus: submenus next to their entry, the 128 patches in one scrolling list (like the original on the Mac); keys work; the patch loads into part 1; the browser shows the chosen bank.

items.title: Wavetable list opens without delay
steps: OSC page, oscillator 1 in Wavetable mode: right-click the table name a few times, move the mouse over the columns.
items.expect: the list appears at once and the highlight follows the mouse without lag (last round: a short delay).

items.title: REMOTE page
steps: PATCH UTILITY > REMOTE. Single-click template 3 (it is only highlighted), then double-click it.
Click the Template Name field, type MY TEST, Return. Click knob VALUE 2, click the KNOB NAME field, type CUT, Return.
Arrow at the right end of MIDI STRING: Control Change > Volume (Ctrl 7) on Ch 1. Then set MIDI Channel Behaviour to Enable and back to Disable.
Close and reopen the plug-in window (or the DAW project).
items.expect: after the double-click the LCD shows "Remote Templates Selected Temp" and the template name; the list shows MY TEST at 3; the text fields fit their boxes while typing; VALUE 2's name CUT; MIDI STRING B0 07 * with the info line Control Change Ch 1, 7, Value above it; the channel menu changes; after reopening everything is still there; the Virus keeps playing normally.

items.title: REMOTE LOAD and SAVE
steps: Double-click template 5. LOAD: look through the places; pick a factory template (e.g. under Remote Templates > Ableton) if one is listed.
SAVE > Personal Remote Templates > Save as new Template..
Double-click template 6, LOAD > Personal Remote Templates > the file you just saved.
items.expect: LOAD lists the places that have templates (note which ones and whether the factory templates appear); the loaded template's name shows at 5; a new file named after template 5 appears; template 6 gets the same name.
